title: Supreme Court allows Trump administration to lift deportation protections for Haitians, Syrians
summary: On Thursday, the predominantly Republican US Supreme Court authorised President Donald Trump's administration to revoke, without judicial review, a temporary status that protects 350,000 Haitian immigrants and 6,000 Syrians from deportation.
